import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
waste_df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj_df = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Calculate median
median = waste_df['Waste_value'].median()
print(f"Median waste value: {median}")

# Create adjacency dictionary with minimum 3 neighbors
adj_dict = {}
valid_boroughs = set(waste_df['borough'])
for borough in waste_df['borough']:
    neighbors = adj_df[adj_df['borough'] == borough]['neighbor'].tolist()
    valid_neighbors = [n for n in neighbors if n in valid_boroughs]
    if len(valid_neighbors) >= 3:  # Only include boroughs with ≥3 neighbors
        adj_dict[borough] = valid_neighbors

# Identify spots with majority criteria
hot_spots = []
cold_spots = []

for borough, neighbors in adj_dict.items():
    borough_value = waste_df[waste_df['borough'] == borough]['Waste_value'].values[0]
    neighbor_values = [waste_df[waste_df['borough'] == n]['Waste_value'].values[0] for n in neighbors]
    
    # HH: Borough above median + majority neighbors above median
    if borough_value > median and sum(n > median for n in neighbor_values)/len(neighbors) >= 0.6:
        hot_spots.append((borough, float(borough_value), float(np.mean(neighbor_values))))
    
    # LL: Borough below median + majority neighbors below median
    if borough_value < median and sum(n < median for n in neighbor_values)/len(neighbors) >= 0.6:
        cold_spots.append((borough, float(borough_value), float(np.mean(neighbor_values))))

# Print results
print("\nReliable Hot Spots (HH):")
for spot in sorted(hot_spots, key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    print(f"{spot[0]}: Borough={spot[1]:.4f}, Neighbors avg={spot[2]:.4f}")

print("\nReliable Cold Spots (LL):")
for spot in sorted(cold_spots, key=lambda x: x[1]):
    print(f"{spot[0]}: Borough={spot[1]:.4f}, Neighbors avg={spot[2]:.4f}")

median = waste_df['Waste_value'].median()

for borough in waste_df['borough']:
